KTM_KUMARAKOM.desc: An easy lakeside day just outside Kottayam: early birdwatching at Kumarakom sanctuary, a boat across Vembanad to Pathiramanal island, driftwood art and old Thazhathangady.
KTM_KUMARAKOM.itin:
7:00 AM — Pickup: Kottayam railway station · Kottayam KSRTC bus station · your hotel in town (Hotel pickups in town)
7:30 AM — Kumarakom bird sanctuary: A shaded lakeside trail with herons, egrets and cormorants, best in the cool morning. (Entry own expense)
9:30 AM — Vembanad boat & Pathiramanal: Across Kerala's largest lake to a quiet bird island, then a karimeen lunch, own expense. (Boat paid direct)
2:00 PM — Bay Island Driftwood Museum: Driftwood shaped into sculptures by a retired teacher. (Closed Mondays · entry own expense)
3:15 PM — Thazhathangady: Old riverside trading street on the Meenachil and its centuries-old Juma Masjid. (Mosque seen from outside)
4:30 PM — Drop-off: Kottayam station, KSRTC bus station, or your own stop in town
KTM_KUMARAKOM.gtk:
🐦 Birdwatching: Mornings are best; November to February brings the most migratory birds. Walk quietly, no feeding; binoculars help.
🗓️ Mondays: The Driftwood Museum is closed on Mondays. On Mondays we add time on the lake or a longer stop at Thazhathangady.
🛶 On the lake: Licensed boats only, life jackets for everyone; the boatman decides if wind or rain is too strong. Pathiramanal has no shops — no plastic, take everything back.
🕌 Respect at the mosque: We see the Juma Masjid and its carvings from outside; entry is at the mosque's discretion. Modest dress for everyone in Thazhathangady.
KTM_KUMARAKOM.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
KTM_KUMARAKOM.exc: Lake boat (paid direct); Lunch, sanctuary and museum entry; Tolls and parking (private trips)
KTM_KUMARAKOM.carry: Hat and sunscreen; Binoculars if you have them; Insect repellent; Clothes covering shoulders and knees

KTM_VAGAMON.desc: Kottayam's own hill station, two hours away: misty pine forest, rolling green meadows below the Kurisumala skyline, a quiet lake and big valley views from Thangalpara.
KTM_VAGAMON.itin:
7:00 AM — Pickup: Kottayam railway station · Kottayam KSRTC bus station · your hotel in town (Breakfast stop at Pala)
9:45 AM — Pine forest: Walk under tall pines on the slopes just outside Vagamon town. (Entry own expense)
11:00 AM — Vagamon meadows & lake: Rolling grass hills with the Kurisumala view, then the calm lake. Lunch in town, own expense.
1:30 PM — Adventure park, Kolahalamedu: Paragliding in season and the glass bridge, when open. (Paid direct · operators confirm)
3:00 PM — Thangalpara: Hilltop rocks and a shrine with sweeping views over the valleys. (Easy uphill walk)
6:45 PM — Drop-off: Kottayam station, KSRTC bus station, or your own stop in town
KTM_VAGAMON.gtk:
🪂 Paragliding & glass bridge: Paragliding runs in season and only when the weather allows; pay the operator directly. The glass bridge has been closed for strengthening — we tell you before the trip if it's open.
🌧️ Weather: Mist rolls in most afternoons; grass slopes are slippery after rain. Best from September to May; heavy-rain alerts can close viewpoints or the trip.
⛰️ Hill road: The last hour climbs a narrow road from Erattupetta via Theekoy. Prone to motion sickness? Sit in front and skip a heavy breakfast.
👟 Walking: Meadows, pine forest and Thangalpara involve short uphill walks. Elderly guests can enjoy most views close to the road.
KTM_VAGAMON.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
KTM_VAGAMON.exc: Meals; Entry, paragliding and park tickets; Tolls and parking (private trips)
KTM_VAGAMON.carry: Light jacket; Walking shoes with grip; Raincoat or umbrella; Cash for entry fees

KTM_ILLIKKAL.desc: Kottayam's wild high country in a day: a forest waterfall at Marmala, the misty rock towers of Illikkal Kallu and the wide green bowl of Ilaveezhapoonchira, 'the valley where no leaves fall'.
KTM_ILLIKKAL.itin:
6:30 AM — Pickup: Kottayam railway station · Kottayam KSRTC bus station · your hotel in town (Breakfast stop at Erattupetta)
8:45 AM — Marmala falls: A tall waterfall in the forest beyond Theekoy, reached by a short estate walk. (View only · no bathing)
10:30 AM — Illikkal Kallu: Three rock peaks at about 3,500 ft, with views to the sea on clear days. Lunch at Melukavu after. (Steep walk · jeep paid direct)
2:00 PM — Ilaveezhapoonchira: A wide grassy valley ringed by hills, with a small check-dam pond and big skies. (Easy walks)
6:45 PM — Drop-off: Kottayam station, KSRTC bus station, or your own stop in town
KTM_ILLIKKAL.gtk:
🪨 At Illikkal Kallu: The last stretch to the top is a steep walk of under 1 km; local jeeps may run from the lower parking, paid direct. The narrow 'hell bridge' ridge between the peaks is off limits for our groups.
⛈️ Weather: Mist, wind and lightning come up fast — we leave the hilltop at the first thunder. Marmala and the rock paths are skipped after heavy rain; red-alert days are cancelled.
👟 Fitness: Good for anyone who can manage a steep 20–30 minute climb. Elderly guests can enjoy Ilaveezhapoonchira and the viewpoints near the road.
🍱 Food: Village eateries only — simple Kerala meals. Carry water and snacks; there are no shops at the hilltops.
KTM_ILLIKKAL.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
KTM_ILLIKKAL.exc: Meals; Local jeep and any entry fees (paid direct); Tolls and parking (private trips)
KTM_ILLIKKAL.carry: Walking shoes with grip; Light jacket or raincoat; Cap and sunscreen; Cash for the jeep and food

KTM_TEMPLES.desc: Faith and old Kottayam in a day: two great Shiva temples, St Alphonsa's shrine at Bharananganam, churches with Persian crosses and riverside Thazhathangady.
KTM_TEMPLES.itin:
7:00 AM — Pickup: Kottayam railway station · Kottayam KSRTC bus station · your hotel in town (Temples first, before noon)
7:15 AM — Thirunakkara Mahadeva Temple: Kottayam's 500-year-old Shiva temple, with fine murals and a koothambalam. (Temple dress code)
8:30 AM — Ettumanoor Mahadeva Temple: A celebrated Shiva temple, famous for its murals. (Closes at noon)
10:30 AM — Bharananganam: Tomb of St Alphonsa, India's first woman saint. Lunch in Pala after. (Modest dress)
2:15 PM — Valiyapalli & Cheriyapalli: 16th-century churches with Persian crosses and old wall paintings. (Quiet during services)
3:30 PM — Thazhathangady: Old riverside trading street and its centuries-old Juma Masjid. (Mosque seen from outside)
4:30 PM — Drop-off: Kottayam station, KSRTC bus station, or your own stop in town
KTM_TEMPLES.gtk:
🛕 Temple customs: Men remove shirts inside; women wear a saree, churidar or long skirt. By custom, entry inside is for Hindus; other guests see the towers and outer grounds.
🕰️ Timings: Temples close from about 11 AM–12 noon until 5 PM, so we visit them first. Festival days bring crowds and changed timings — we re-confirm before your trip.
⛪ Churches & mosque: Enter quietly; no photos during Mass or prayers. Thazhathangady Juma Masjid is seen from outside unless the mosque invites us in.
👟 Comfort: Footwear stays outside temples — stone yards get hot by late morning. Little walking otherwise; good for elderly guests.
KTM_TEMPLES.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
KTM_TEMPLES.exc: Lunch; Offerings and any camera fees; Tolls and parking (private trips)
KTM_TEMPLES.carry: Mundu / dhoti or modest clothes; Shawl or dupatta; Small cash for offerings; Water bottle and hat

KTM_KOCHI.desc: Five centuries of Kochi in a day from Kottayam: Chinese fishing nets, India's oldest European church, a Dutch palace of murals, Jew Town and Marine Drive.
KTM_KOCHI.itin:
7:00 AM — Pickup: Kottayam railway station · Kottayam KSRTC bus station · your hotel in town
9:30 AM — Fort Kochi: fishing nets & churches: Chinese fishing nets, St Francis Church (Vasco da Gama's first grave) and Santa Cruz Basilica. (Modest dress in the churches)
11:15 AM — Mattancherry Palace: The 'Dutch Palace' with its Ramayana murals and royal portraits. (Closed Fridays · entry own expense)
12:00 PM — Jew Town & Paradesi Synagogue: Antique shops, spice stores and the 1568 synagogue. Lunch here, own expense. (Synagogue closed Fri & Sat)
2:30 PM — Kerala Folklore Museum: Masks, costumes and carved wooden halls from across South India. (Entry own expense)
4:00 PM — Marine Drive: A walk on the backwater promenade before the drive home.
7:00 PM — Drop-off: Kottayam station, KSRTC bus station, or your own stop in town
KTM_KOCHI.gtk:
🗓️ Closing days: Mattancherry Palace is closed on Fridays; the synagogue on Fridays, Saturdays and Jewish holidays. On those days we swap in the Hill Palace Museum at Tripunithura — same price.
👗 What to wear: Shoulders and knees covered for the churches, synagogue and palace. No photos inside the synagogue or the palace galleries.
🚶 Walking: Fort Kochi and Jew Town are best on foot — about 3–4 km of easy walking in all. Wear comfortable shoes; lanes are uneven in places.
🚐 The drive: About 2–2½ hours each way via Ettumanoor, Thalayolaparambu and Tripunithura. Evening traffic at Vyttila and Tripunithura can make the drop a little later.
KTM_KOCHI.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
KTM_KOCHI.exc: Lunch; Palace, synagogue and museum entry; Tolls and parking (private trips)
KTM_KOCHI.carry: Comfortable walking shoes; Clothes covering shoulders and knees; Hat and sunscreen; Cash for entry fees

KTM_COK.desc: Flying out of Cochin International? Start at your own door in Kottayam, Ettumanoor or nearby and step out at the right terminal — or land in Kochi and we drive you home.
KTM_COK.itin:
Pickup — Your door: Home or hotel in Kottayam, Ettumanoor, Kumarakom or nearby, Kottayam station or KSRTC stand — at the time we agree for your flight.
On the road — ~88 km on the MC Road: About 2.5–3 hours via Ettumanoor, Kuravilangad, Muvattupuzha and Perumbavoor, with a short break if you need one.
Drop-off — Cochin International Airport: Domestic (T1) or international (T3) departures. Reverse trips start from the arrivals exit. (No waiting charges on arrivals)
KTM_COK.gtk:
✈️ Timing your trip: Leave at least 6 hours before an international flight and 5 hours before a domestic one. Muvattupuzha and Perumbavoor towns jam at peak hours — we plan around them.
🛫 Which terminal?: Domestic flights use T1; international flights use T3. Check your ticket and tell us — we drop you at the right kerb.
🧳 Luggage: Hatchbacks and sedans suit 2–3 people with check-in bags. Families with large bags: choose an MPV, Premium SUV or Traveller.
🔁 Landing in Kochi?: Share your flight number; we track delays and meet you at the arrivals exit with a name board. We track your flight — no waiting charges if it lands late.
KTM_COK.inc: Door-to-door pickup; No waiting charges on arrivals; Driver bata; Fuel and per-km charges
KTM_COK.exc: Tolls and airport parking; Meals on the way
KTM_COK.carry: Passport / ID and tickets; Flight number shared with us; Terminal (T1 / T3) noted; Water for the drive

KTM_TRV.desc: Flying out of Trivandrum? Start at your own door in Kottayam, Changanassery or Thiruvalla and step out at the right terminal — or land in Trivandrum and we drive you home.
KTM_TRV.itin:
Pickup — Your door: Home or hotel in Kottayam, Changanassery, Thiruvalla or nearby, Kottayam station or KSRTC stand — at the time we agree for your flight.
On the road — ~160 km on the MC Road: About 4–4.5 hours via Changanassery, Thiruvalla, Adoor, Kottarakkara and Venjaramoodu, with a break at Adoor.
Drop-off — Trivandrum International Airport: T1 domestic or T2 international (Chakkai). Reverse trips start from the arrivals exit. (No waiting charges on arrivals)
KTM_TRV.gtk:
✈️ Timing your trip: Leave at least 7.5 hours before an international flight and 6.5 hours before a domestic one. Town jams at Changanassery, Thiruvalla, Adoor, Kottarakkara and in the city can add time.
🛫 Two terminals: T1 (domestic) and T2 (international, Chakkai) are on opposite sides of the runway. Check your ticket and tell us the terminal.
🧳 Luggage: Hatchbacks and sedans suit 2–3 people with check-in bags. Families with large bags: choose an MPV, Premium SUV or Traveller.
🔁 Landing in Trivandrum?: Share your flight number; we track delays and meet you at arrivals. We track your flight — no waiting charges if it lands late.
KTM_TRV.inc: Door-to-door pickup; No waiting charges on arrivals; Driver bata; Fuel and per-km charges
KTM_TRV.exc: Tolls and airport parking; Meals on the way
KTM_TRV.carry: Passport / ID and tickets; Flight number shared with us; Terminal (T1 / T2) noted; A light snack for the drive

KTM_THEKKADY.desc: Walk a cardamom and pepper plantation, catch a Kathakali or Kalaripayattu show, and take the morning boat into the Periyar Tiger Reserve — about four hours from Kottayam.
KTM_THEKKADY.itin:
Day 1 · 7:00 AM — Pickup & drive: From your door, hotel, Kottayam station or KSRTC stand; about 115 km via Pampady, Kanjirappally and the Kuttikkanam ghat, roughly 4 hours with breaks.
Day 1 · afternoon — Spice plantation tour: Cardamom, pepper, cinnamon and coffee with a local guide. (Paid direct)
Day 1 · evening — Kathakali or Kalaripayattu: Kerala's classical dance-drama or martial art at a Kumily theatre. Overnight in Thekkady. (Optional, paid direct)
Day 2 · 7:30 AM — Periyar Lake boat cruise: The first sailing — the best time to see elephants, gaur and deer at the water's edge. (Limited seats · tickets in advance)
Day 2 · late morning — Chellarkovil viewpoint: A cliff-edge view over the Cumbum valley and Tamil Nadu plains.
Day 2 · ~5:00 PM — Drive home: Down the ghat after lunch; back at your door in Kottayam by early evening.
KTM_THEKKADY.gtk:
🛶 Periyar boating: Only a few sailings a day with limited seats — we help you book tickets in advance. Animal sightings are never guaranteed; boats stop in storms.
🌿 Spice shopping: Buy from plantations or fixed-price shops in Kumily. Leeches on plantation paths in the wet season — wear socks.
🏨 Your stay: You book your hotel in Kumily or on Thekkady Road. Your driver's night allowance is in our price.
🛣️ The drive: Ghat road after Mundakayam — carry motion sickness tablets if needed. Sabarimala season (mid-Nov to mid-Jan) slows Ponkunnam and Kanjirappally — we start earlier.
KTM_THEKKADY.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 2 days; All Thekkady sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowance; No waiting charges
KTM_THEKKADY.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Boat, plantation and show tickets; Tolls and parking
KTM_THEKKADY.carry: Light jacket; Walking shoes; Binoculars; Cash for tickets

KTM_MUNNAR.desc: Waterfalls on the climb, tea estates as far as you can see and the Nilgiri tahr of Eravikulam — Kerala's favourite hill station, about five hours from Kottayam.
KTM_MUNNAR.itin:
Day 1 · 6:30 AM — Pickup & drive up: From your door, hotel, Kottayam station or KSRTC stand; about 140 km via the MC Road, Muvattupuzha and Kothamangalam, roughly 5 hours with breaks.
Day 1 · 10:00 AM — Cheeyappara & Valara falls: Roadside waterfalls in the Neriamangalam forest — a short photo stop. (Fullest in the monsoon)
Day 1 · midday — Tea Museum: How tea goes from leaf to cup, at Nullatanni. Lunch in Munnar town. (Closed Mondays · entry own expense)
Day 1 · afternoon — Mattupetty Dam & Echo Point: Lake views and optional boating on the Top Station road. Overnight in Munnar. (Stay booked by you)
Day 2 · morning — Eravikulam National Park: Park buses take you up Rajamala to see the Nilgiri tahr. (Tickets online · closed ~Feb–Mar)
Day 2 · ~6:30 PM — Drive home: Leave Munnar by 1:30 PM; back at your door in Kottayam by evening.
KTM_MUNNAR.gtk:
🐐 Eravikulam: Tickets are sold online in time slots — book a few days ahead; we can help. Closed for the tahr calving season, usually February–March; then we go to Top Station instead.
🍃 Tea & spices: Tea estates are private land — photograph from the roadside. Spice gardens at Pallivasal and Kallar are optional, paid direct.
🏨 Your stay: You book your hotel; Munnar town, Pothamedu and Chithirapuram are popular. Your driver's night allowance is in our price.
🧥 Weather & roads: Cool mornings, cold in December–January — bring a layer. In heavy-rain alerts hill roads can close at night — we plan to be off the ghat before dark.
KTM_MUNNAR.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 2 days; All Munnar sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowance; No waiting charges
KTM_MUNNAR.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Park, museum and boating fees; Tolls and parking
KTM_MUNNAR.carry: Warm jacket; Walking shoes; Motion sickness tablets; Cash for entry fees

KTM_SABARIMALA.desc: Your own vehicle from Kottayam to Nilakkal base camp for the 2026-27 Mandala–Makaravilakku season, with an Erumely stop on the way — the driver waits to bring you home.
KTM_SABARIMALA.itin:
≈5:00 AM — Pickup: From your door — home, hotel, Kottayam station or KSRTC stand. (Example: 10 AM slot)
On the road — Via Ponkunnam & Kanjirappally: About 52 km on the Kottayam–Kumily road to Erumely, with a tea break.
≈6:30 AM — Erumely (optional): Petta Thullal at the Petta Sastha temple and a visit to Vavar Palli. (Tell us when booking)
≈8:30 AM — Nilakkal base camp: Private vehicles stop here; KSRTC chain buses take you on to Pampa. (Bus fare paid direct)
Day — Pampa, the climb & darshan: About 5 km uphill on foot to Sannidhanam, darshan, and the walk back. (Virtual Queue booked by you)
≈10:30 PM — Home: Your driver waits at Nilakkal and brings you home the same night.
KTM_SABARIMALA.gtk:
📱 Virtual Queue: Book your darshan slot yourself at sabarimalaonline.org; carry the QR coupon and the same photo ID. Spot-booking counters are limited — don't count on them.
🅿️ Nilakkal & Pampa: Private vehicles are not allowed to Pampa — KSRTC chain buses run from Nilakkal. Save your driver's number and the parking block.
🗓️ Season 2026-27: The temple opens on 16 Nov 2026; Mandala Pooja is on 27 Dec; Makaravilakku in mid-January 2027. Peak days bring police holds and long queues — we re-confirm before you travel.
❤️ The climb: About 5 km of steep forest path — go slow; medical centres with oxygen line the route. Elderly pilgrims and heart patients: check with your doctor first.
KTM_SABARIMALA.inc: Private vehicle and driver for the day; Erumely stop on request; Driver bata; No waiting charges at Nilakkal
KTM_SABARIMALA.exc: KSRTC Nilakkal–Pampa bus; Meals and offerings; Virtual Queue booking (done by you); Tolls and parking
KTM_SABARIMALA.carry: QR coupon and photo ID; Irumudi kettu; Torch and a warm layer; Your medicines and water

KTM_ALAPPUZHA.desc: Drive from Kottayam down the AC Road to Alappuzha, board a houseboat by noon and drift through Kuttanad's canals and paddy fields, with a night on the water.
KTM_ALAPPUZHA.itin:
Day 1 · 10:00 AM — Pickup: From your door — home, hotel, Kottayam station or KSRTC stand.
Day 1 · 10:15 AM — Drive to Alappuzha: About 48 km via Changanassery and the AC Road through Kuttanad's paddy fields, roughly 1.5 hours.
Day 1 · 12 noon — Board your houseboat: Cruise the backwaters with lunch, dinner and breakfast cooked on board. Overnight on the boat. (Houseboat booked by you · paid direct)
Day 2 · 9:00 AM — Check-out at the jetty: Your driver meets you at the boarding point with the vehicle.
Day 2 · 9:30 AM — Beach, Karumadi & Ambalappuzha: Optional — Alappuzha beach and pier, the old granite Buddha at Karumadi and the Ambalappuzha Sri Krishna temple. (Temple dress code)
Day 2 · ~1:30 PM — Home: Back to your door in Kottayam via Thakazhi and Thiruvalla.
KTM_ALAPPUZHA.gtk:
🚤 Booking the houseboat: You book and pay the houseboat directly; we can share contacts of licensed operators we trust. Check-in is usually around noon, check-out about 9 AM.
🛏️ On board: Boats stop cruising by early evening and anchor for the night. Ask the operator about AC hours, menus and life jackets.
🚗 Your driver: The vehicle stays with the driver in Alappuzha overnight. His night allowance is in our price.
🌧️ Season: Best from September to March; peak Dec–Jan — book early. In heavy rain the AC Road can flood and cruise routes may be shortened.
KTM_ALAPPUZHA.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 2 days; Kottayam ⇄ Alappuzha jetty drives; Driver bata and night allowance; No waiting charges
KTM_ALAPPUZHA.exc: Houseboat (paid direct); Meals off the boat; Tolls and parking
KTM_ALAPPUZHA.carry: Swimwear and a change of clothes; Mosquito repellent; Sunscreen and hat; ID for the houseboat check-in

KTM_KODAIKANAL.desc: Over the Peermade hills, through Kumily and the Cumbum valley, then up to Kodaikanal's star-shaped lake, cliff walks and pillar rocks — with your own vehicle and driver.
KTM_KODAIKANAL.itin:
Day 1 · 5:30 AM — Pickup & drive to Kodaikanal: From your door in Kottayam — about 255 km via Mundakayam, Kumily, Cumbum and Theni, roughly 9 hours with breaks. (Stay booked by you)
Day 1 · 2:15 PM — Silver Cascade falls: A roadside waterfall on the last stretch of the Kodai ghat. (Monkeys — keep food inside)
Day 1 · evening — Kodai Lake: A walk, a cycle or a boat round the star-shaped lake. (Boating paid direct)
Day 2 · morning — Coaker's Walk & Bryant Park: A cliff-edge path with views to the plains, then the gardens. (Entry own expense)
Day 2 · afternoon — Pillar Rocks, pine forest & Guna Caves viewpoint: Granite pillars, tall pines and the famous caves lookout. (Entry own expense)
Day 3 — Drive home: Leave after breakfast; lunch near Kumily and back at your door in Kottayam by evening.
KTM_KODAIKANAL.gtk:
🎫 Kodaikanal e-pass: Tourist vehicles need a Tamil Nadu e-pass for Kodaikanal — we apply for it. Plastic is restricted: carry refillable bottles.
🪪 Tamil Nadu entry: You cross into Tamil Nadu at Kumily. Interstate permit, border tax and green fee are billed at actual cost. We re-check entry rules before you travel.
🌫️ Viewpoints: Mist can hide Pillar Rocks and Coaker's Walk — mornings are usually clearer. We reorder stops for the best views.
🧥 Weather & roads: Cool all year, cold at night — bring warm layers. Three ghat sections each way: carry motion sickness tablets.
KTM_KODAIKANAL.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 3 days; Kodaikanal sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowances; No waiting charges
KTM_KODAIKANAL.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Entry and boating fees; Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals
KTM_KODAIKANAL.carry: Warm jacket; Photo ID; Walking shoes; Cash for entry fees

KTM_KANYAKUMARI.desc: India's southern tip: the wooden palace of the Travancore kings, a sunset and a sunrise where three seas meet, and a ferry to Vivekananda Rock and the Thiruvalluvar statue.
KTM_KANYAKUMARI.itin:
Day 1 · 6:00 AM — Pickup & drive: From your door in Kottayam. About 250 km down the MC Road via Thiruvalla, Adoor and Trivandrum, 6–7 hours with breaks.
Day 1 · 2:00 PM — Padmanabhapuram Palace: The Travancore kings' carved wooden palace at Thuckalay, after lunch on the way. (Closed Mondays · entry own expense)
Day 1 · evening — Sunset at Kanyakumari: Watch the sun go down at the tip of India. Overnight in Kanyakumari. (Stay booked by you)
Day 2 · ~6 AM — Sunrise over three seas: The famous sunrise from the shore by the temple.
Day 2 · 8:00 AM — Vivekananda Rock & Thiruvalluvar statue: Government ferry to the rock memorial; a glass bridge links it to the statue. (Ferry paid direct · go early)
Day 2 · late morning — Kumari Amman Temple: The ancient shore temple of the virgin goddess. (Men remove shirts · dress code)
Day 2 · ~8:30 PM — Home: About 255 km back to Kottayam — Suchindram temple on the way if it is open.
KTM_KANYAKUMARI.gtk:
🛂 Tamil Nadu entry: Kanyakumari is in Tamil Nadu: interstate permit, border tax and tolls are billed at actual cost. We arrange the permit before your trip.
⛴️ The Rock ferry: Government ferries run from about 8 AM to 4 PM; queues grow after 9 — go early. Tickets paid direct; ferries pause when the sea is rough.
🛕 Palace & temple: Padmanabhapuram Palace is closed on Mondays — on a Monday we visit Suchindram instead. Kumari Amman: men remove shirts; modest dress for all.
🏨 Your stay: You book your hotel; sea-view rooms near the sunrise point fill fast. Your driver's night allowance is in our price.
KTM_KANYAKUMARI.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 2 days; Palace, sunset & temple drives; Driver bata and night allowance; No waiting charges
KTM_KANYAKUMARI.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Ferry, palace and temple tickets; Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals
KTM_KANYAKUMARI.carry: Photo ID; Modest temple clothes; Hat and sunscreen; Cash for ferry and entry

KTM_VELANKANNI.desc: Over the Kumily hills to the Basilica of Our Lady of Good Health at Velankanni — Mass, Our Lady's Tank, candle prayers and a full, unhurried day at the shrine by the sea.
KTM_VELANKANNI.itin:
Day 1 · 4:30 AM — Pickup: Kottayam railway station · Kottayam KSRTC bus station · your hotel in town (≈490 km via Kumily & Trichy)
Day 1 · evening — Evening prayer: Reach Velankanni by about 6 PM; candles and prayer at the Shrine Basilica. (Room booked by you)
Day 2 · 9:00 AM — Mass & Our Lady's Tank: Malayalam Mass at the Morning Star Church, then Our Lady's Tank and the Way of the Cross. (Times re-confirmed)
Day 2 · late morning — Museum & Old Church: The museum of offerings and the Old Church by Our Lady's Tank. Lunch near the shrine (own expense).
Day 2 · evening — Beach & candle prayers: A walk on Velankanni beach, then the evening rosary and candles at the basilica. (No sea bathing)
Day 3 · ≈6:00 PM — Drop-off: Kottayam station, KSRTC bus station, or your own stop in town (Leaves Velankanni 5 AM)
KTM_VELANKANNI.gtk:
⛪ At the shrine: Shoulders and knees covered; follow the volunteers in the queues and keep silence in the chapels. Masses run daily in Tamil, English and other languages — we re-confirm the Malayalam Mass time before you travel.
🌊 Beach & crowds: No sea bathing — the sea is rough and drownings are reported. We fix one meeting point at the main arch; children stay with an adult.
🏨 Your room: You book your own room near the shrine — we share a list of pilgrim lodges. Driver bata and night allowance are in our price.
🛣️ Long road & border: About 490 km each way with breaks every 2–3 hours; ghats in daylight. Tamil Nadu permit and border tax at actual cost; carry a photo ID.
KTM_VELANKANNI.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Driver bata and night allowance; Caretaker for 10+ guests

KTM_LETTERS.desc: Kerala's 'Akshara Nagari': the goddess of learning at Panachikkad, India's first language museum, the 1817 CMS College where Malayalam printing grew, and the riverside Old Seminary.
KTM_LETTERS.itin:
8:00 AM — Pickup: Kottayam railway station · Kottayam KSRTC bus station · your hotel in town (Temple first, before noon)
8:30 AM — Panachikkad Saraswathy Temple: Dakshina Mookambika — the goddess of learning, in a green grove by a pond. (Dress code · see below)
10:00 AM — Aksharam museum: India's first museum of language and letters — scripts, palm leaves, printing. (Entry own expense)
11:30 AM — CMS College heritage: India's oldest college (1817); the CMS Press nearby set early Malayalam type. (Heritage campus)
12:30 PM — Old Seminary, Chungam: Riverside seminary of 1815 with an old chapel. Lunch in town after, own expense. (Modest dress)
2:00 PM — Drop-off: Kottayam station, KSRTC bus station, or your own stop in town
KTM_LETTERS.gtk:
🪔 Panachikkad: Most Kerala temples admit only Hindus inside; other guests see the grove, pond and gateway from outside. Men: shirts off and dhoti or trousers; women: saree, churidar or long skirt. Footwear stays in the vehicle.
🔤 Aksharam: Galleries trace writing from rock art and palm leaves to print and digital Malayalam, with holograms and an immersive theatre. Entry is paid at the counter; we confirm its hours and closing day before your date.
📖 Campuses: CMS College and the Old Seminary are working institutions — we keep to open grounds and the chapel, quietly, on working days. If a campus is closed for an event we spend longer at the museum.
🚉 Pickups: Railway station first, then the KSRTC stand, then hotels in town — we share exact times the evening before. Drop-off in the same places, or at your own stop in town.

KTM_VAIKOM.desc: Vaikom's great Shiva temple and its Satyagraha lanes, Kaduthuruthy's giant stone cross, Kuravilangad's ancient Marian church and St Chavara's Mannanam.
KTM_VAIKOM.itin:
7:00 AM — Pickup: Kottayam railway station · Kottayam KSRTC bus station · your hotel in town (Temple first, before noon)
8:00 AM — Vaikom Mahadeva Temple: Great Shiva temple; its lanes saw the 1924–25 Vaikom Satyagraha. (Dress code · see below)
9:15 AM — Satyagraha memorials: Vaikom's memorials to the temple-road struggle, then the lakeside jetty. (Check opening hours)
10:30 AM — Kaduthuruthy Valiyapally: Old Knanaya church with a great granite cross carved from one stone. (Modest dress)
11:45 AM — Kuravilangad Marth Mariam: Ancient Marian church and its giant bells. Lunch here, own expense. (Modest dress)
2:00 PM — Mannanam · St Chavara: Monastery where St Chavara set up a press and school in 1846; his tomb. (Quiet inside)
3:30 PM — Drop-off: Kottayam station, KSRTC bus station, or your own stop in town
KTM_VAIKOM.gtk:
🛕 Vaikom temple: Most Kerala temples admit only Hindus inside; other guests see the gateways and walk the lanes outside. Men: shirts off and dhoti or trousers; women: saree, churidar or long skirt. Footwear stays in the vehicle.
✊ The Satyagraha: In 1924–25 people of every caste marched for the right to walk the roads around this temple — a landmark of India's freedom era. Memorial museums keep their own hours; if one is closed we show it from outside and spend longer by the lake.
⛪ Churches: Shoulders and knees covered; quiet during mass and prayers. Feast days bring crowds (Kuravilangad's Moonu Nombu, Vaikom Ashtami) — we adjust the order on those days.
